wake: shake only; A wake removed before any device installation
sleep: Original IMU-only PM1 battery standby, ESP32 G13 ext0 fallback on USB; no new hour cutoff
awake_led: PM1 LED_EN cleared and read back at startup/restore

diagnostics.checkpoints: before sleep and every 5 awake minutes outside launch/motion capture; last interval may be lost on abrupt power loss
diagnostics.records: boot/sample/pre-sleep/wake voltage, charging/LED/boost/tournament/sensor flags, backlight, CPU frequency, PM1 wake flags
diagnostics.counters: boots, shake/power/other wakes, sleep attempts, awake/charging/LED/boost/display time
diagnostics.sleep_duration: USB RTC-retained deep sleep counted; battery CPU power-cut sleep duration explicitly unknown
diagnostics.current_ma: unavailable; not a fuel gauge or per-component current meter
diagnostics.USB_export: P observational power log; p live status
diagnostics.bench_sleep: S invokes normal save/sleep path without changing saved timeout

validation.device_flash: App-only flash/device hash verified; 20 KB NVS identical before startup
validation.runtime: 0.10.7 confirmed; ~50 kS/s, zero overflow/read errors; awake LED off
validation.display: Actual battery frame verified: A next page B main occupies one line, ink x=10..122 on 135px screen; same font/text on history/motion/Settings
validation.history: 128 launches, 24 sessions, generation 403; saved single-turn, 3-minute timeout, 30% brightness preserved

brightness.controls: Settings: hold B selects Sleep/RPM/Brightness; hold A changes/saves selected row
brightness.restore: startup, shake wake and failed-sleep recovery
brightness.zero_percent: not offered; sleep still switches backlight off

battery_page.clock: cancelled; no time sync or clock in application; shake-only battery standby cuts processor power
battery_page.footer: A next page B main; dark grey at y=219

navigation: History, battery, motion/recreate and Settings: A next page B main; tap actions unchanged
